clue.text: One sultan moves to annex British port

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: to annex is to take in, so the shuffled letters take the B inside them
the letters of sultan move about into a new order

explanation.surface: A sultan relocates in order to seize a British harbour town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moves' rearranges SULTAN to STANUL, and 'to annex' puts B inside it, after I.
explanation.definitionFit: Istanbul is a major Turkish seaport on the Bosphorus.

clue.text: Horseman spots revolutionary American taken inside

indicators.note: the American abbreviation is taken inside the reversed word
revolutionary means turned round, so the word for spots is read backwards

parts.note: a rash is an outbreak of spots

explanation.surface: A cavalryman notices a revolutionary American held captive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' looks like it describes the American, but it turns the spots word round.
explanation.definitionFit: A hussar is a light cavalry soldier, so a mounted military rider.

clue.text: Stuart Goddard's alter ego in Spain becomes unbreakable

parts.note: Stuart Goddard is the real name of the pop singer Adam Ant
E is the international vehicle code for Spain (España)

explanation.surface: A pop star's stage persona, once abroad in Spain, turns out to be indestructible.
explanation.walkthrough: Adam Ant fronted the 1980s band Adam and the Ants; his birth name is Stuart Goddard.
explanation.definitionFit: Adamantine means hard as diamond or adamant, hence impossible to break.

clue.text: Tap dancing cue observed in Grease

indicators.note: the rearranged letters are seen inside the word for grease

parts.note: grease means fat

indicators.note: dancing letters jig about, so the word cue is rearranged

explanation.surface: A tap-dance cue spotted in the musical Grease.
explanation.walkthrough: Tap and Grease suggest the dance and the musical; Tap is the definition and Grease is plain fat.
explanation.definitionFit: Faucet is the American word for a water tap.

clue.text: Mature 19 dropping Juliet among children

indicators.note: among puts the shortened name in the middle of the word for children

parts.note: seed is an old word for offspring or descendants

indicators.note: dropping means losing a letter, here the one for Juliet

parts.note: the answer to 19 across is JASON
Juliet is J in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A grown-up Jason, minus Juliet, mixing with children.
explanation.walkthrough: Seed in the sense of offspring is biblical usage.
explanation.definitionFit: Seasoned means experienced or aged, like matured timber or a mature professional.

clue.text: Key passage that has no opening note

indicators.note: the passage word loses its first letter, which is also a musical note

parts.note: an aisle is a passage between seats
A is a note of the musical scale

explanation.surface: A crucial corridor in a piece of music that lacks its first note.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has no opening' removes the A from AISLE.
explanation.definitionFit: A key, or cay, is a low island, so a small isle.

clue.text: Wild roo, seen in Mull, causing mirth

indicators.note: the scrambled letters are seen inside the word for mull

parts.note: mull is a type of loose forest humus

indicators.note: wild means unruly, so the letters of roo are scrambled

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A wild kangaroo spotted on the Scottish island of Mull is a funny sight.
explanation.walkthrough: Mull looks like the Scottish island, but it is a type of soil; 'Wild' shuffles roo and 'seen in' places the result inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Something humorous is funny, provoking laughter.

clue.text: Dashing hope to live as goddess

indicators.note: dashing means rushing about, so the letters of hope are rearranged

parts.note: to be is to exist, to live

explanation.surface: A dashed hope of living like a goddess.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dashing' rearranges HOPE to PHOE.
explanation.definitionFit: Phoebe is a Titan goddess of Greek myth, and an epithet of Artemis as moon goddess.

clue.text: Crush together to restrict a Frenchman in survival drama

indicators.note: to restrict is to hem in, so the other letters are held inside

parts.note: to squidge is to squash or squeeze together
M is short for Monsieur, a Frenchman

explanation.surface: Squashing people together to confine a Frenchman in a survival show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to restrict' puts A and M inside SQUIDGE.
explanation.definitionFit: Squid Game is the South Korean television series about deadly contests for survival.

clue.text: Country stunner appearing in art house cut

indicators.note: the stunner abbreviation appears inside the rearranged letters
cut, as a film is edited, means the letters of art house are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
a knockout, KO, is a stunning blow

explanation.surface: A stunning actress turns up in an art-house film's edited version from a particular country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' rearranges ART HOUSE to SOUTHREA, and 'appearing in' puts KO inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: South Korea is the nation on the southern half of the Korean peninsula.

clue.text: Rich Tea provided in westbound service area

indicators.note: westbound in an across clue means read right to left, so the letters are reversed

parts.note: Mass is a church service

explanation.surface: A Rich Tea biscuit on sale at a westbound motorway service area.
explanation.walkthrough: Rich Tea is a British biscuit, but here it is the definition. 'westbound' reverses MASSA.
explanation.definitionFit: Assam is a strong, full-bodied Indian black tea.

clue.text: Crate containing small part needed for pot

indicators.note: containing means the box word holds the small abbreviation inside

parts.note: a case is a box or crate
a role is a part played

explanation.surface: A packing crate holding a small part required for a cooking pot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'containing' acts only on the small abbreviation; the part word then follows.
explanation.definitionFit: A casserole is a lidded cooking dish, a type of cooking vessel.

clue.text: Title holder from circle in London borough

indicators.note: in puts the circle letter inside the borough name

parts.note: Barnet is a borough of north London
a circle is shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: A titled person from some social circle living in a London borough.
explanation.walkthrough: BARNET is a London borough; 'in' puts O inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A baronet holds a hereditary title ranking below a baron.

clue.text: Disagreeable moose in for treatment

indicators.note: something going in for treatment is worked on and altered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A grumpy moose is brought in to be treated by the vet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for treatment' rearranges MOOSE IN.
explanation.definitionFit: Noisome means offensive or unpleasant, especially of smells.

clue.text: Having entered roundabout maybe showing command?

parts.note: having entered, you are in
a roundabout is one kind of road junction

explanation.surface: Having driven onto a roundabout, perhaps you see a sign giving an order.
explanation.walkthrough: A roundabout is a British traffic circle.
explanation.definitionFit: An injunction is an authoritative order, especially from a court.

clue.text: One's put on something inspirational, or simple garment?

indicators.note: put on means the letter for one goes after the lung word in the across entry

parts.note: a lung is the organ that breathes in, a whimsical sense of inspiration
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Someone dons something inspiring, or perhaps just a plain piece of clothing.
explanation.walkthrough: Inspiration literally means breathing in, so a lung is 'something inspirational'.
explanation.definitionFit: A lungi is a plain cloth wrapped round the waist, worn in South Asia.

clue.text: Turning over weapon to a Conservative is useless

indicators.note: turning over means flipping the weapon word end to end

parts.note: a gun is a weapon
a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: Handing over a weapon to a Conservative politician achieves nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turning over' reverses GUN to NUG.
explanation.definitionFit: Nugatory means of no value or force, futile.

clue.text: Fox seen in Stroud here and there

indicators.note: here and there means only scattered, alternating letters of the town name are taken

explanation.surface: A fox spotted in various places around Stroud.
explanation.walkthrough: Stroud is a Gloucestershire town; 'here and there' takes its 2nd, 4th and 6th letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Tod is an old northern and Scots word for a fox.

clue.text: Groom's worthless horse consumed by quartet

parts.note: tit is an old word for a small or inferior horse
IV is four in Roman numerals
consumed means ate

explanation.surface: A stable groom's useless horse eaten by a group of four.
explanation.walkthrough: Groom is the verb here, not the stable hand.
explanation.definitionFit: To titivate is to smarten up one's appearance, as grooming does.

clue.text: European indeed very nice at first, in one sense a 23 24

parts.note: ja is German or Dutch for yes, indeed
so means very

indicators.note: at first means only the opening letter of nice is used

explanation.surface: A very nice European turns out to be a golden retriever, in a way.
explanation.walkthrough: Jason retrieved the Golden Fleece, so he is a 'golden retriever' in one sense.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek hero Jason went on a quest to bring back the Golden Fleece.

clue.text: Disturbance involving Jolly Jack — establish truth?

indicators.note: involving means the disturbance word wraps round the sailor

parts.note: noise is a disturbance
a jolly Jack tar is a sailor, TAR

explanation.surface: A rowdy sailor in a fracas has to prove what really happened.
explanation.walkthrough: Jolly Jack Tar is an old nickname for a British sailor; 'involving' wraps the noise word round him.
explanation.definitionFit: To notarise is to certify a document as authentic before a notary; the question mark flags the loose sense.

clue.text: Fixed clothing FBI agents cut up

indicators.note: clothing means wrapping round, so the agents go inside

parts.note: set means fixed
G-men are FBI agents (government men)

explanation.surface: Fixed clothing worn by FBI agents gets slashed to pieces.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clothing' reads as garments but is a verb meaning wrapping round.
explanation.definitionFit: To segment is to divide into parts, which is what cutting up does.

clue.text: Butcherbird with high-pitched cry turning tail?

indicators.note: turning tail means the last pair of letters of the cry are swapped round

parts.note: a shriek is a high-pitched cry

explanation.surface: A bird that gives a shrill cry before fleeing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning tail' reverses the EK at the end of SHRIEK to give KE.
explanation.definitionFit: Shrikes are called butcherbirds because they impale prey on thorns.

clue.text: Drunk goes around talking about this evening

indicators.note: goes around means the drunk word surrounds the other piece

parts.note: tight means drunk
on means about, as in a talk on a subject

explanation.surface: A drunk wanders about chattering about tonight's plans.
explanation.walkthrough: 'goes around' looks like the drunk staggering, but it signals the containment.
explanation.definitionFit: Tonight refers to the present or coming evening.

clue.text: Trust's foremost in City for capital cover

indicators.note: foremost means only the first letter of trust is used

parts.note: urban means in a city

explanation.surface: A trust's foremost concern in the City is protecting capital.
explanation.walkthrough: Capital means the head here, not money.
explanation.definitionFit: A turban is a cloth wound around the head, so a covering for the head.

clue.text: Even terrier pants going after good old breed

indicators.note: going after places the rearranged letters after the good-old pieces
pants, as slang for rubbish, says the letters of even terrier are mangled

explanation.surface: Even the terrier pants as it chases a fine old breed of dog.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pants' rearranges EVEN TERRIER to ENRETRIEVER.
explanation.definitionFit: The golden retriever is a popular gun dog breed.

clue.text: See 23
Russian front to Italy's south

indicators.note: south in a down clue means the front word goes below the Italy letter

parts.note: I is the international vehicle code for Italy
van, short for vanguard, is the front

explanation.surface: A Russian battle front lies to the south of Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down answer, 'south' of a piece means after it.
explanation.definitionFit: Ivan is a common Russian first name, used for a typical Russian.

clue.text: Bank invests pound for working man

indicators.note: invests means surrounds or besieges, so the bank word wraps the pound sign

parts.note: a tier is a bank or row, as of seats
L is the abbreviation for pound (libra)

explanation.surface: A bank puts money into a labourer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'invests' puts L inside TIER.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiler is a tradesman who lays tiles.

clue.text: See 10
Old wife in Seattle needing repair for dryers

indicators.note: in puts the two abbreviations inside the rearranged letters
needing repair means broken, so the letters of Seattle are rearranged

explanation.surface: An elderly wife in Seattle whose clothes dryers need fixing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needing repair' rearranges SEATTLE to TEATELS, and 'in' puts O and W inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Tea towels are cloths for drying dishes.
